# Project conventions
Shared product, domain, specification, decision, and review material belongs in docs/. Reuse docs/index.md as the reading map. Contributor checkpoints live in .work/ with a discoverable .work/index.md. .work/ is already excluded locally; do not change global settings. Keep unrelated contributor records intact. Campaign progress follows the specific convention in this fixture. Current explicit user instructions take precedence. Save meaningful design or review output in the repository; label proposals and unresolved questions honestly. Do not commit, publish, message others, or use external services.
When implementing, write behavioral tests before implementation, use Python standard-library unittest, and document durable responsibilities in code. No dependencies or network access are needed.

# Reusable behavior
Authors publish numbered versions. Customers use the same version in multiple places with different local retry limits. The first sketch has TileInstall and JobInstall, whose binding lifecycles are the same. Execution engines are out of scope. Users need to know which version each use is on. Nothing is accepted yet.
